# Welcome to my website!

I am Chadi Nahal, MD, a general surgery resident pursuing fellowship training in cardiothoracic surgery. I completed by Bachelor's of Science in Bioengineering at University of California, Los Angeles and Medical Doctorate at Saint Louis University School of Medicine. I am currently completing a 2 year combined research fellowship at the Cleveland Clinic and Master's in Clinical Research at Case Western Reserve University School of Medicine. 

My research interests include clinical outcomes research, specifically in mitral and aortic surgical techniques and pathologies. I also study the diagnostic utility for cardiac MRI for surgical planning. I have applied by engineering background to use computer software to segment MRI and CT images and perform statistical analysis to diagnose surgical pathologies and predict outcomes after surgery.

I spend my time at the Cleveland Clinic conducting research, coordinating research, and dissecting cadaver specimens for anatomical teaching to medical students. I have completed two years of general surgery and have strong clinical experience that has provided me the surgical and procedural skills to teach and serve the community. 

My hobbies include backpacking, camping, fishing, rock climbing and weight lifting. I also enjoy sketching and gardening. I also enjoy cooking. See some of photos of my hobbies on the hobby page.  

On this website, you will find my curriculum vitae which provides an in-depth summary of my experiences and publications. 

Please feel free to [contact me](mailto:mail.chadinahal1@gmail.com) if you have any questions or would like to discuss potential projects.
